rounds.critic: Independent Orc clinic art and construction reviewer

models.observations: At 64 × 64 in both Information and Ascension, the red receiving canopy and unequal blue tanks distinguish the clinic from the Hospital's three blue wards. The cream cross sits on the dark canopy badge, and the hall and tank caps change from charcoal to ochre. The package validator passed. Independent triangle inspection of the 996/590/299-triangle levels found gaps at the canopy, pipes and badge, and the high-detail door is hidden behind the hall wall.
defects: Move the door assembly forward under the canopy. A frontal sample of 8,176 points on the leaf found the hall wall ahead of every point at LOD0 and 53% at LOD1. At LOD0 the center of the leaf is at z=-0.2422 while the wall at y=0.16 is at z=-0.2698.

Seat both canopy posts in the awning at all three levels. The nearest post-to-canopy distances on the negative and positive X sides are 0.0066/0.0071 at LOD0, 0.0153/0.0158 at LOD1, and 0.0606/0.0013 at LOD2. The horn tips also miss the awning.
Extend the pipes into the receiving hall. The tall and short tanks' pipe ends miss the wall by 0.0089 and 0.0518 at LOD0. The short tank's pipe still misses by 0.0594 at LOD1.
Extend the clinic badge backing into the coarsest canopy. At LOD2 the shortest gap between the disk and awning measures 0.0050.

models.observations: At 64 × 64 the red triage awning, raised cream cross and staggered blue tank pair distinguish the clinic from the Hospital's three blue ward roofs in both ages. Charcoal caps turn ochre in Ascension while the medical sign keeps its contrast. On the 1006/600/309-triangle levels, all 8,176 frontal door samples clear the hall wall. Both posts enter the canopy, their horn tips intersect its shell, and the sign stem intersects both disk and canopy. Each pipe intersects its tank and the hall on the two levels carrying pipework.
